title: The Speed Portal
description: Race endlessly through 4 3D tunnel distance zones (Warmup, Overclock, Hyperdrive, Singularity), dodging barriers and laser spokes while threading speed rings.

maker.name: Madi AI Creative Team
maker.bio: Building the future of autonomous revenue engines.

instructions: Rotate around the tunnel interior with A/D or Left/Right to dodge red barriers and laser spokes. Thread emerald speed rings for boosts and to recharge your Energy Shield every 3 rings.
